subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 5.
solution: The correct answer is 'had arrived.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • In the given sentence, we are talking about 'Pandas' in Past tense. • Therefore, we need 'had arrived' and other options are ruled out. • When you need to talk about two things that happened in the past and one event started and finished before the other one started, place **“had”** before the main verb for the event that happened first. • Example:* Chloe **had **walked the dog before he fell asleep.* • Therefore, the correct answer is 'had arrived.' • The correct sentence: *The pandas **had arrived** in Canada in 2014 and were due to stay for 10 years.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • When we are talking about the past: for any subject (I, You, He, She,It, We, They) we use ‘had been‘. • **“Had been,”**, suggests an action that both began and ended in the past. • Example: *I had been reading articles on English language for three hours.​* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • दिए गए वाक्य में, हम भूत काल में 'Pandas' के बारे में बात कर रहे हैं। • इसलिए, हमें **'had arrived'** की आवश्यकता है और अन्य विकल्पों को खारिज कर दिया गया है। • जब आपको अतीत में हुई दो चीजों के बारे में बात करने की आवश्यकता होती है और एक घटना शुरू होती है और दूसरी शुरू होने से पहले समाप्त हो जाती है, तो पहले हुई घटना के लिए मुख्य क्रिया से पहले **"had"** रखें। • Example:* Chloe had walked the dog before he fell asleep.* 79:Te0d, The correct answer is- '**you buy**.'
